primary_meaning: A title for God (specifically God the Father) as the eternal, sovereign Judge who sits on the throne in heavenly court, receiving dominion and glory, and before whom the Son of Man appears.

alternatives.meaning: A title or appearance of Christ (the pre-incarnate or exalted Son) as the eternal Judge
basis: some patristic and later Christian interpreters

alternatives.meaning: A theophany or vision of the Godhead / divine council without strict Trinitarian person distinction
An exalted angelic or hypostatic figure distinct from God
basis: some historical-critical and non-Christian readings of Daniel

notes: In mainstream Christian interpretation the phrase attiq yomin / Ancient of Days is overwhelmingly treated as a designation of God (Father) in Daniel’s judgment scene; identification with Christ is a frequent secondary christological reading but not the primary consensus default.
